title: Chimney Drop Runner
heading: Chimney Drop
help: Pick a step and click Green flag. Left and right arrows move the sleigh; Space drops a present.

1.name: The sleigh
1.note: If key pressed, change x, in a forever loop.

2.name: Houses
2.note: The House makes a clone of itself and of the Chimney; they move left together.

3.name: Presents
3.note: Space makes a Present clone at the sleigh; it falls to the snow.

4.name: Delivered!
4.note: Touching a Chimney scores, and the chimney glows.

5.name: The sack
5.note: A miss costs a present; at 0 Santa says goodbye and the game stops.

6.name: Snow and speed
6.note: Snow clones; speed = 2 + score / 5. This is the whole game.
